description: Finds the pages (or queries) that lost the most clicks against a comparison period and gives a first reading of why: a ranking loss, fewer impressions, or a lower click-through rate. For the worst cases it also lists what lost the most underneath (the queries of a page, or the pages of a query). Use it to plan content refreshes and to investigate traffic drops.

compare_end_date.description: Last day of the comparison period when compare_to is "custom".

compare_start_date.description: First day of the comparison period when compare_to is "custom".

compare_to.description: What to compare against: the same number of days immediately before (default), the same period 52 weeks earlier, or a custom range (set compare_start_date and compare_end_date).

days.description: Length of the period in days, used when start_date is not given. Default 28.

dimension.description: Look for declining pages or declining queries.

end_date.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific Time, or "today" / "yesterday". Defaults to the latest day Google has complete data for, usually 3 to 4 days ago. A later date includes days that are still incomplete.

explain_top.description: For this many of the worst rows, also fetch the breakdown underneath. Each costs two API calls; 0 turns it off.

filters.description: Filters; a row must match all of them. Example: [{"dimension":"page","operator":"contains","expression":"/blog/"},{"dimension":"country","operator":"equals","expression":"usa"}]. Countries are ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes, devices are DESKTOP, MOBILE or TABLET, and the regex operators use RE2 syntax.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

min_drop_pct.description: Only report rows whose clicks fell by at least this percentage.

min_previous_clicks.description: Only consider rows that had at least this many clicks in the comparison period.

scan_rows.description: How many rows to read from Search Console before analysing. Google returns rows sorted by clicks, so a larger scan reaches further into low-click, high-impression rows. Each 25,000 rows is one API call.

search_type.description: Which Google surface: web (default), image, video, news (the News tab), discover or googleNews.

site_url.description: Search Console property, for example "sc-domain:example.com" or "https://www.example.com/". A bare domain or any page URL on the site also works. Optional when GSC_SITE_URL is set or the account has exactly one property.

start_date.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific Time. Defaults to `days` before end_date.

name: find_declining_pages
title: Find declining pages
